m01:room.title: The Metabolism Glasshouse
m01:room.job: Find out whether a sick cassava leaf loses carbon over a whole day.

m02:room.title: The Root Transport House
m02:room.job: Find out which rinse leaves a root cell unchanged.

m03:room.title: The Signal Imaging Lab
m03:room.job: Find out whether the border roots have slowed, and whether the calcium flash comes first.

m04:room.title: The Expression Glasshouse
m04:room.job: Find out whether the root turned its defense gene up, or its DNA changed.

m05:room.title: The Crossing House
m05:room.job: Find out whether resistance in Family 2 travels as one dominant gene.

m06:room.title: The Linkage Analysis Trailer
m06:room.job: Find out how often marker B parts company with the resistance allele.

m07:room.title: The Sequence and Protein Lab
m07:room.job: Find out which codon holds the changed base, and what the change does to the receptor.

m08:room.title: The River Pathology Lab
m08:room.job: Find out how much PV-7 is in the root, and whether the controls show it caused the rot.

m09:room.title: The Challenge Phenotyping House
m09:room.job: Find out which line stops PV-7, and what stopping it costs at harvest.

m10:room.title: The Seed Vault Atrium
m10:room.job: Find out whether the packed crate carries the valley's resistance variety.

m11:room.title: The Evolution Trial Canopy
m11:room.job: Find out whether the season's spray selected the resistant strains of PV-7.

m12:room.title: The River Ecology Station
m12:room.job: Find how fast the rot is spreading and whether the river is carrying it.

m13:room.title: The Rhizosphere House
m13:room.job: Find out whether the screened root partner feeds a plant the way field soil does.

m14:room.title: The River Mesocosm Hall
m14:room.job: Find out whether a pilot tank holds enough oxygen through a whole night.

m15:room.title: The Harvest Decision Room
m15:room.job: Find out whether the pilot can leave the valley without carrying PV-7 or losing variety.
